title: NASA and SpaceX target Oct. 7 for Crew-12 undocking from ISS
detail: NASA and SpaceX set undocking of the Crew-12 Dragon from the ISS for no earlier than 1:05 a.m. EDT Wednesday, Oct. 7, after a weather and splashdown-conditions review off California. Splashdown is expected around 11:25 a.m. on Oct. 8. Crew members Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway, Sophie Adenot and Andrey Fedyaev return after Crew-13's arrival; a change-of-command ceremony on Oct. 4 hands ISS command from Meir to Pyotr Dubrov.
